戈德伦.who: 白骸，钟城骨匠会的骨匠。约纷争纪10731年，他把三千节骨头没有一节在原处的老师送上钟楼，九夜拆、九夜接，第十八天天亮老师站直了，钟城的骨匠听完报数把三千节叫开。长垒这一边只记着随营拆骨的骨匠。

at.text: 约10731年戈德伦在钟城钟楼上拆了九夜、接了九夜，每拆一节报一个数，第十八天天亮老师站直了。10791年赫班送来一批伤者，赛奥菈在工场外替他们遮住旧影，他一面接骨一面教来人认自己身上的那一节。
这些年戈德伦照旧在钟城钟楼底下的工场里给错接的骨复位，伤者醒着便先问姓名或营号。南边的神一位接一位凋零，看清魔神要吃他们的人越来越多，看清了也没有人说出口。
10992年萌芽月，戈德伦跟骨匠德鲁姆来到盐海北岸的老滩，在湿沙上拿碎骨摆弗劳洛斯的骨架，摆一节，记一节。往后六夜他攀在祂的骨架上，拆下一节报一个数，第六夜扳开了祂长回去以前的那一道缝。

quotes: 疼就告诉我，疼的位置有用，你忍着我反倒摸不准。
戈德伦.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3218到3255行凡世至强三千节·戈德伦。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10791年钟城），补卷_96 钟城·影子先敲了门。at 19：势力/地点、声口称谓，时段_七 第14行世道。at 20：时段_七 第19行（摆骨架）、第41行（攀在骨架上报数、扳开缝）。总表第220行。

格兰托.who: 炎角，生下来的那一座营叫头一台擎天级一脚踩平。约纷争纪9890年，他把南段对面一道光秃的石岭从头到尾点着，火烧三夜，擎天级在岭前停了三夜，第四天掉头，岭后那几处的人叫他赤岭的火。

at.text: 约9890年格兰托把双角抵进石岭，火烧了三夜，头一台擎天级在岭前停了三夜，第四天转回墙下，往后那一道岭叫赤岭。10191年达尔凯来岭后送粮，两人为哪几辆车先让路吵过一回，吵完一起把堵在谷口的铁甲烧开。
这些年格兰托照旧守在赤岭后头炎角的几处驻地，带同族的冲阵人迎向比自己高得多的东西，墙上有许多人死在他的角火下。南边的神一位接一位凋零，魔族里看清这一层的人越来越多。
10992年萌芽月，格兰托领着炎角从北边的高地下来，到了盐海北岸的老滩。天一亮营里的人往南去，他跟奥兹嘉守老滩的北口，挡北边压下来的忠于魔神的大军，头半个月把火铺在北口外的几条路之间，奥兹嘉死后他接住冲回来的炎角。

quotes: 奥兹嘉，这一回从我左边过，火给你留开。
格兰托.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3296到3333行凡世至强赤岭的火·格兰托。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10191年），补卷_96 赤岭·火里有座桥。at 19：势力/地点、位阶与职责一句、往后的事，时段_七 第14行。at 20：时段_七 第20行、第34行、第50行，条目往后的事（北口头半个月）。

罗佩丝.who: 深潮，盐海北岸老滩的母亲。约纷争纪10612年蝉鸣月盐海一退三十里，她把自己的孩子放进最后一只水桶，独自走到裸露的海床上，四十夜一尺一尺把潮牵回了岸，盐沼里几百户深潮人家叫她回岸的潮。

at.text: 约10612年罗佩丝在退出三十里的海床上背向岸牵了四十夜，潮回了旧岸，几百户人家的水槽又有了水。10761年铎尔贡来老滩帮盐田重打水闸，两人在低堤外挡过一回倒流潮。
这些年罗佩丝照旧住在盐海北岸老滩低处的盐池边，守着近岸的水，替老滩牵海兽和搁浅的船。南边的神一位接一位凋零，看清魔神要吃他们的人越来越多，看清了也没有人说出口。
10992年萌芽月，罗佩丝跟茜洛恩和几位深潮的有名者从盐海里上来，先去看盐田里退水的沟。天一亮营里的人往南去，她把盐海的咸水牵上岸，水从一道一道干沟里立起来流到珂伦娜脚边，珂伦娜拿它绕着死水威沛的营座围了一圈。

quotes: 珂伦娜，岸上交给你，我去把水带来。
罗佩丝.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3140到3177行凡世至强回岸的潮·罗佩丝。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10761年），补卷_96 红晶滩·床脚又湿了。at 19：势力/地点、位阶与职责、往后的事，时段_七 第14行。at 20：时段_七 第19行、第38行。

赛奥菈.who: 梦魇的影魔，在死域北沿三座旧营里长大。约纷争纪10790年霜降月，她把三处帐火下的影子连成一道黑帘遮了三夜，第四台擎天级从营前走过三回没有看见，营里的人趁这三夜往西挪出了死域的边，那三处的人叫她三夜的帘。

at.text: 约10790年霜降月赛奥菈牵起影帘，三夜里第四台擎天级从帘前走过三回，帘后近万人往西挪出了死域的边。10791年她随伤者到钟城，夜里坐在戈德伦的工场门口，替接骨的人遮掉缠在身后的旧日影子。
这些年赛奥菈照旧在死域北沿往西撤出来的那几条路之间来往，替正在撤走的人遮住形迹，歇下来喜欢坐在灯旁吃东西。南边的神一位接一位凋零，魔族里看清这一层的人越来越多。
10992年萌芽月，赛奥菈在老滩的帐外试了一回影子，篝火还烧着，从高处看下来只剩一片空沙。天一亮营里的人往南去，她升到三处营座当中的半空，把影子连成一道帘，攥着当中那一幅主影，三夜里剩下的那几尊看不清南边出了什么事。

quotes: 你怎么坐到暗里去了？灯边这块归你，我早留好了。
赛奥菈.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3335到3372行凡世至强三夜的帘·赛奥菈。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10791年），补卷_96 钟城·影子先敲了门。at 19：势力/地点、位阶与职责、性格底色，时段_七 第14行。at 20：时段_七 第20行、第33行，条目往后的事。

赫班.who: 白骸，十八营出身的盾手。约纷争纪10503年寒星月，三座营叫弗劳洛斯一夜吃空，没了营的三百来人被排在冲阵最前头，他立一面骨盾挡在前头，炮打了十一天，盾长到二十丈宽，三百人一个不少，盾后的人叫他空营的盾。

at.text: 约10503年寒星月赫班的骨盾在长垒的炮火里一天往两边长一丈，十一天后三百来人贴着盾根走全了。10791年他护送一批从北沿撤出的伤者到钟城求戈德伦接骨，守在下街的入口替担架挡开挤过来的铁兽。
这些年赫班照旧在南段对面死域北沿的驻地，做没了家的那一队人最前面的盾手，护住他们在前线一块能站的地。南边的神一位接一位凋零，看清魔神要吃他们的人越来越多，看清了也没有人说出口。
10992年萌芽月，赫班走在卡尔泽因左边来到盐海北岸的老滩，背上一面比人还宽的骨盾，扎帐子时先拿盾压住帐门迎风的一侧。天一亮他在卡尔泽因左边举盾挡最强的那一尊，盾一夜往两边长一丈，削下的骨片在他脚下堆成了坡。

quotes: 卡尔泽因，我守左边，你别跟着转。
赫班.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3179到3216行凡世至强空营的盾·赫班。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10791年），补卷_96 钟城·影子先敲了门。at 19：势力/地点、位阶与职责，时段_七 第14行。at 20：时段_七 第18行、第40行。挡的那一尊是谁条目写只给模型，文字不点名。

达尔凯.who: 绯宴的血魔，宴主十二家里一家的小儿子。约纷争纪10190年，一群野机兵出了死域往北冲着一座营城去，他在焦原上划开手腕，血落地成一线拉开九里，烧成火墙，他站了三天，那一座营城的人叫他不回头的血。

at.text: 约10190年达尔凯的血线在焦原上烧了三天，野机兵的弦在火里耗尽，整列朝北跪下，营城里的人撤到了北坡。10191年他带补给去赤岭，借格兰托的火熔开被野机兵堵死的谷路。
这些年达尔凯照旧住在南边的前锋营，跟赤岭后方的运粮车来往，在外头不报家名。南边的神一位接一位凋零，看清魔神要吃他们的人越来越多，看清了也没有人说出口。
10992年萌芽月，达尔凯在老滩上坐在维斯洛旁边磨剑，三个人坐到天亮。他随维斯洛和茹瑟娅往马拉克斯的营座去，挨近了祂，剑上的火缩回到护手。第二天茹瑟娅倒在腐潮停住的那一线上，他从她手里拿走了那只空碗。

quotes: 茹瑟娅，碗给我，你先把手放下。
达尔凯.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3257到3294行凡世至强不回头的血·达尔凯。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10191年），补卷_96 赤岭·火里有座桥。at 19：势力/地点，时段_七 第14行。at 20：时段_七 第18行、第35到36行，条目往后的事（空碗）。

铎尔贡.who: 轰狱的牛魔，锻营帮锤人的儿子。约纷争纪10760年第四台擎天级踏过砧家的前线锻营，他从断铁梁里拔出只认砧家血的主锤，锤面亮了，一锤砸在擎天级左膝上，擎天级跪下一条腿退了，砧家的人笑他拿的是没主的锤。

at.text: 约10760年铎尔贡那一锤落下，第四台擎天级左膝的刻纹一圈圈熄灭，跪下一条腿退了，那一柄主锤从此跟着他。10761年他到老滩帮罗佩丝立水闸，学会把锤收小一点落，免得一锤毁掉整条堤。
这些年铎尔贡照旧在南段对面砧家的前线锻营，拿着那一柄不认血缘主人的大锤，奉的是拆墙者拜恩。南边的神一位接一位凋零，魔族里看清这一层的人越来越多。
10991年霜降月擎山那三天，铎尔贡在山脚阵里连着击碎巨甲推出的石脊，霍尔妲死在他的锤下，拜恩倒下时锤上分来的火也矮了。10992年萌芽月他把空了的神徽朝下放在老滩的沙上，白天替盐圈挡浪，夜里替骨匠背骨。

quotes: 没人给我，我捡的。要我放回去吗？
铎尔贡.note: 条目：纷争纪时段_六 第3374到3411行凡世至强无主之锤·铎尔贡。at 18：凝名伟业、往后的事（10761年），补卷_96 红晶滩·床脚又湿了。at 19：势力/地点、位阶与职责，补卷_70 第113行（这时还奉着拜恩），时段_七 第14行。at 20：补卷_70 擎山第118到119行，时段_七 第20行，条目往后的事。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年，反叛的那一个月里
falls.where: 死域北沿，骨拱的末一节下
falls.how: 弗劳洛斯倒下以后，剩下的那几尊压了过来，戈德伦拿满地断骨撑起一道三里长的苍蓝骨拱，叫背骨的人从拱底下过塌沟。拱叫那几尊压下来的火一节一节砸断，他守着末一节，一撤手拱就塌，背骨的人还没过完，他没有撤。最后一个人钻过去，末一节跟着他的脊背一起折断。
falls.name: 末一节
falls.light: pale blue glow from the bone arch and the threads on his fingers, against a dark night sky torn by falling columns of white-red divine fire from above
falls.camera: low near the ground beside the foot of the last span, looking up past the crawling carrier to the white-skull bonesmith and the burning sky, tilted slightly
falls.text: Scene: night on the northern edge of the dead zone, a cracked plain of grey ash and broken giant bones, the air full of smoke and falling sparks. From the top of the frame columns of white-red fire are crashing down out of a black sky, their sources cut off by the frame, each column the width of a tower; where they land, the long bridge-like arch behind is already smashed. The arch is built of enormous pale bones laid end to end and glows a soft pale blue; it runs from the far distance toward us, and only the last span near the right foreground still stands, about four times a man's height, its stones of bone cracking along the top. Under that last span, at the right of the picture, the white-skull bonesmith stands braced with his back and shoulders pushed up against the underside of the arch, seen from the side at three-quarter, his face turned toward us and to the left: a slim young-looking demon man of about twenty-six, slender frame, very large hands, ash-violet short hair combed to one side, amber-green eyes, bone horns curving from behind his ears down to his cheeks, pale skin dotted with tiny old stitch scars, a long leather work apron with tight cuffs, scorched and torn, an empty bone ring on the middle finger of his right hand. From all ten of his fingers thin glowing blue threads run and wrap around the foot of the arch; his fingers are bent back by the strain, blood at the fingertips, burns along his forearms, his jaw set. Beneath the span on the left, a white-skull carrier with a huge pale bone strapped to his back is crawling through on hands and knees toward the open plain on the left, almost out. Far behind, at the broken end of the arch, a pack of dark iron wolves pours into the gap. Blue sparks, bone dust and grey ash drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：骨拱一节一节叫那几尊压下来的火砸断，他守着末一节，一撤手拱就塌，最后一个背骨的人钻过去，末一节跟着他的脊背一起折断。画的是最后一个人快钻过去、他还撑着的那一下。三里长的骨拱照条目，二幕写的是德鲁姆接两百里骨拱、戈德伦守最后几节缝，两处说法不一样。没有挂 beast，压下来的几尊不点名，只画落下来的火。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年，反叛的那一个月里
falls.how: 反叛不到一个月里最后一回冲锋，压上来的是十几万忠于魔神的兵，前头倒下一排，后头踩着接上一排，不计死伤。格兰托身后是老滩，盐圈还亮着，他走得掉，没有走，把火引进双角，扑进正在落下的巨角冲车底下，化作一团赤焰，炸开一里宽的熔坑横在北口当中。
falls.name: 北口火
falls.light: a blinding red-orange blaze from his burning horns lighting everything from below, against a dusky smoke-brown sky
falls.camera: low and close behind him at the lower left, looking up the slope at the falling siege engine and the endless army beyond, strongly tilted
falls.text: Scene: dusk at a narrow pass north of a salt shore, red rock slopes on both sides, the ground already cracked by streams of molten rock from earlier charges. Filling the upper half of the frame is an enormous horned battering engine, black as a moving tower, plated in iron and bone with great curved horns at its prow, tipping forward and coming down toward us; its top is cut off by the frame. Behind it, filling the pass and the hills to the horizon, an army of a hundred thousand demon soldiers in dark armor and banners presses forward in rank after rank. In the near foreground, slightly left of center, the flame-horned giant is seen from behind at three-quarter, facing away from us toward the falling engine: a huge broad-backed demon man over two meters tall, red-tinted skin, curly copper-red hair, a pair of deep red horns spreading outward, a small faded baby's cloth band tied around the middle of his right horn, a short beard, a long-hafted copper war axe dropped at his feet. He has lowered his head and driven both horns up under the engine's prow, his whole body bracing against it; fire is pouring into his horns so that they blaze white-hot from root to tip, and a long crack runs through both horns. Blood runs down his neck and shoulders, his armor is burnt and split, the skin of his arms glows with heat. Behind him, small in the lower right, a few flame-horned fighters run back toward him through the smoke. Sparks, embers and flakes of hot rock drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：他把火引进双角，将冲车顶起，两角在半空断裂，扑入落下的冲车下，化作一团赤焰炸开一里宽的熔坑。画的是双角顶住冲车、角已经裂开的那一下，熔坑炸开以前。死在十几万的军团手里，也是燃尽，他身后是老滩、盐圈还亮着。守的地方条目写老滩北口，二幕写北边的谷口。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年萌芽月，反叛的第五天
falls.how: 反叛的第五天，罗佩丝把最后一股水送进了珂伦娜画的盐圈，几百里外的浪墙一段一段翻过来，全灌进圈里，那一夜那一圈咸水一齐白了。她的鳞从手到肩一片一片剥落，倒在了圈里，跟死水威沛同一天。
falls.name: 最后一股
falls.light: the ring of salt water glowing white like heated iron, cold night blue everywhere else, the white light striking her from below and in front
falls.camera: behind her right shoulder at the edge of the ring, looking across the glowing ring toward the demon god, slightly high and tilted
falls.text: Scene: night on the northern edge of the dead zone, a flat land of grey ash beside a dark salt sea. On the right half of the frame, rising from a turbid spring on a black stone platform, stands the demon god of dead water, a towering figure made of murky standing water that does not flow, waterweed-like black hair hanging down, its head cut off by the top of the frame. Around its seat runs a wide ring of salt water raised above the ground like a low wall, and the whole ring is glowing white like iron in a forge; the turbid water inside heaves but cannot get through. Behind, far out on the sea, walls of waves taller than towers roll in one after another toward the ring. In the left foreground the deep-tide woman stands at the edge of the ring, seen from behind at three-quarter, facing away from us toward the god: a tall full-shouldered demon woman who looks about twenty-eight, very long lake-green hair down past her waist, fine teal scales on her neck and the backs of her hands, a thin damp cloak over a plain dress from neck to ankle, a pair of salt-crystal bands on her wrists. Both her arms are stretched forward, and from her hands a last thick stream of sea water rises from the dry channels behind her and arcs over into the white ring. The teal scales on her hands and forearms are peeling away in flakes up to the shoulder, the skin beneath raw and bleeding, her knees beginning to give. Far to the left, small, a four-armed serpent woman with a scroll at her waist stands at the ring's edge. Salt spray, white flakes of salt and drops of water drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：第五天她把最后一股水送进了盐圈，那一夜那一圈咸水一齐白了，鳞从手到肩一片一片剥落，倒在圈里。画的是送最后一股水、鳞正在剥落、还站着的那一下。死水威沛的样子照补卷_82 第45、82行（浑水凝成的高影、水草般的黑发）。远处四只手的蛇魔是珂伦娜，没有写进 who。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年萌芽月，反叛的第四天
falls.where: 死域北沿，三处营座之间的半空
falls.how: 反叛的第四天，别处压过来的魔神破开了帘顶，天光从帘当中撕了进来，几百里的黑影从高处一齐垂落。赛奥菈攥着的那一幅主影在手里碎了，人从半空跌下来，绿发在裂口照下来的光里一下子白了。
falls.name: 帘顶
falls.light: a harsh white shaft of daylight tearing down through a jagged rent in a sky-wide black curtain, everything else in deep violet shadow
falls.camera: far below, looking almost straight up at her small figure against the torn curtain, with a strong tilt
falls.text: Scene: the moment of dawn high above the northern edge of the dead zone, the ground far below a dim grey waste with three distant demon encampments glowing faintly red. Filling the whole sky from edge to edge hangs a vast curtain of black shadow, layered like folds of dark cloth, stretched over the land for miles; at its center a jagged rent is tearing open from the top of the frame, and through it a hard white shaft of daylight falls straight down. Something enormous is pressing through the rent from above, only a huge dark edge of it visible before the frame cuts it off. Just below the rent, small in the middle of the picture, hangs the shadow dancer in mid-air, seen from below, her face lifted toward the light: a slender demon woman who looks about twenty-five, chin-length mint-green hair falling over one ear, deep violet eyes, pale lilac skin, small black horns behind her ears, a dark coat with a red lining showing at the sleeves, closed from neck to ankle. With both hands she grips the central fold of the shadow curtain, which is splitting between her fingers into black shreds; her arms are pulled wide by it, her body arched, a thin line of blood at the corner of her mouth, and at the ends of her hair, where the white light touches, the green is turning white. Long black strands of shadow are sliding down past her toward the ground on every side. Far below on the left, very small, a cart carrying wounded still lies under a last patch of shadow. Torn black shreds of shadow and specks of white light drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：第四天别处压过来的魔神破开帘顶，几百里的黑影一齐垂落，她攥着的主影在手里碎了，人从半空跌下，绿发在光里一下子白了。画的是主影正在碎、她还悬着的那一下。破帘的那一尊条目没有点名，没有挂 beast，只露一道暗边。帘的大小条目写几百里，二幕写几十里，照条目。最后一片影盖着拉伤兵的车照二幕第33行。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年，反叛的第六夜
falls.how: 赫班在卡尔泽因左边挡最强的那一尊，挡了六夜，把自己的肋骨接进盾里。第六夜快天亮的时候盾碎了，骨片散了半里地，他拿左臂抵着碎盾，叫那一尊的刃光连人压进了钟前的地里，没有再起来。
falls.name: 钟左盾
falls.light: the grey first light before dawn, a cold white glare from the giant blade above, pale sea-blue glow running over the cracked bone shield
falls.camera: low on the ground in front of the shield and a little to the left, looking up at the shield, the man and the descending blade, tilted
falls.text: Scene: the grey hour before dawn on the northern edge of the dead zone, a high stone platform in a field of ash. Coming down from the top of the frame is an enormous unsheathed blade, wider than a city gate, its edge glowing cold white, the hand and body that hold it cut off by the frame; it is pressing down onto a great curved shield of white bone that rises from the ground and bends over in an arch, the size of a house. The shield is cracking through, splinters of bone already flying, its back laced with thin sea-blue light, and a scatter of bone plates carved with old numbers lies around it on the ground. Under the arch of the shield, in the middle foreground, the white-skull shieldbearer is braced on one knee, seen from the front at three-quarter and facing up and to the right toward the blade: a huge broad-chested demon man who looks about twenty-nine, short snow-white hair, sea-blue eyes, a wide low brow, an old copper ring bound around his left horn, pale skin, the back of his neck ridged with white bone, his outer coat open and torn. His left arm and shoulder are pushed hard against the inside of the shield, bone plates from his own shoulders grown into its edge, blood running from his shoulder and side, his jaw clenched, his eyes steady. On the right edge of the picture, partly cut off and seen from behind, a tall gaunt grey-skinned white-skull man holds up a small bronze bell in his left hand and strikes it with an iron pestle, a ring of pale sound rippling out from it. Bone dust, white splinters and grey ash drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：第六夜快天亮的时候盾碎了，他的左臂还抵着碎盾，叫压进了钟前的地里。画的是盾正在碎、他还撑着的那一下。最强的那一尊是无鞘的刀安托士，条目写只给模型、不点破，文字只写一柄巨刀，beast 挂了任务单给的安托士显像。右边敲钟的是卡尔泽因，照新添说明不写 who，只在 text 里写背影。 主会话 11-15：那一尊不点破，显像的参考图拿掉了，只留画框切掉的一柄巨刀。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年萌芽月，反叛的第三天
falls.how: 反叛的第三天，马拉克斯营座前的腐泥漫到了腰，达尔凯把茹瑟娅的空碗放在一块高出泥的石头上，划开手腕拉出一道血线，往座前烧过去。挨近了祂，他身上的光一点一点矮下去，先离开脸，再离开胸口，他走到线的半路倒了下去，血线照旧烧到了座前。
falls.name: 半路血线
falls.light: a dull dark-red gloom from the god's seat, the burning blood line the brightest thing in the picture, its red glow on his legs and the mud
falls.camera: low near the mud surface behind and to the left of him, looking along the burning line toward the seat, tilted
falls.text: Scene: a sour grey afternoon on the northern edge of the dead zone, a wide hollow flooded with dark rotting mud that steams and bubbles. In the upper right, at the far end of an endless long table half sunk in the mud, sits the demon god of unripe rot, a huge dark-red shadow on a high seat with sealed wine jars at its side, its head cut off by the top of the frame; everything near it looks spoiled and blackened. From the lower left foreground a single line of blood runs straight across the mud toward that seat, burning red-hot like a thread of lava, and wherever it passes the mud hardens into a narrow path. On a stone that rises just above the mud in the left foreground rests a small empty bowl. In the middle of the picture the crimson feaster walks along the burning line away from us, seen from behind at three-quarter, his face turned a little to the left: a tall slim-waisted blood demon who looks about twenty-three, long wine-red hair tied high, blue-gold slit-pupiled eyes, thin horns sweeping back from his brow, pale skin, a loose-collared dark coat with red copper buttons at the cuffs, fingerless gloves, a long sword with a narrow blood groove in his right hand, its point dragging in the line. His left wrist is cut open and blood pours from it into the line. The rot mud reaches his waist, his face has gone pale and grey, the red light draining out of him from the head down, his steps heavy. Far behind him, small, a lean dark-haired swordsman follows the same line. Steam, flecks of black mud and red sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：第三天腐泥漫到腰，他把碗放在高出泥的石头上，划开手腕拉出血线，红光先离开脸再离开胸口，走到线的半路倒下。画的是他还在走、光正在退的那一下。马拉克斯的样子照补卷_82 第50、81行（暗红巨影坐在长桌尽头、封口酒坛）。远处跟着走的是维斯洛，样子没对立绘，只写成小小的背影。

falls.when: 纷争纪10992年，反叛最后那几天
falls.how: 反叛最后那几天，剩下的那几尊把盐海掀了起来，一道比城墙还高的浪往老滩压过来。铎尔贡站在浪前，一锤一锤砸进浪根，锤柄从手心里断开，他抱住锤头接着砸，浪在他跟前塌了下去，他也倒在了浪前，锤头沉进了海底。
falls.name: 浪根
falls.light: a dark storm-grey sky, violet-white hammer fire flashing along the base of the wave and running out to sea, lighting him from below
falls.camera: low on the wet sea floor behind and to the right of him, looking up past his shoulder at the towering wave, tilted
falls.text: Scene: a stormy evening on a salt shore, the sea pulled back so that dark wet sea floor lies bare in front of the land. Filling the whole upper part of the frame is a single wave higher than a city wall, black-green and streaked with foam, curling over toward us, its crest cut off by the top of the frame. At its foot, in the middle foreground, the hornless-hammer bull demon is seen from behind at three-quarter, facing away from us into the wave: a giant demon nearly two and a half meters tall, broad chest and back, thick limbs, deep bronze skin, short ochre-gold hair, two horns of uneven height, silver-white hammer burns on his forearms, a short leather smith's apron with a pieced-on extension tied at his waist. He has just swung: the haft of his great hammer has snapped and hangs splintered, and he is hugging the heavy iron hammer head in both arms and driving it into the root of the wave, where violet-white fire bursts out and races along the base of the water far out to sea. The palms of his hands are torn and bleeding, splinters of the haft stuck in them, his back streaming with water and blood, his feet sunk into the sea floor. Far behind him on the right, small, a ring of white salt glows on the shore, with tiny figures of wounded inside it. Spray, foam and violet sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 条目往后的事：剩下那几尊把盐海掀起来，一道比城墙还高的浪往老滩压过来，他一锤一锤砸进浪根，锤柄断开，抱住锤头接着砸，浪塌了，他倒在浪前，锤头沉进海底。画的是锤柄刚断、抱着锤头砸进浪根的那一下。掀浪的那几尊不点名，没有挂 beast。任务单给的拜恩参考图这一幅用不上，拜恩上一年已经倒了。

notes: 七位在第十九张的年份里源稿都没有专记他们的事，at 那一段写照旧在哪、做什么，加时段总纲里看清这一层的人越来越多那一句，主会话看要不要更短。
戈德伦的骨拱条目写他自己撑起三里长的一道，二幕第48行写德鲁姆接两百里骨拱、戈德伦守最后几节缝，falls 照条目。
格兰托守的地方条目写老滩北口，二幕写北边的谷口，where 照条目写老滩北口。
赛奥菈的影帘条目写几百里，二幕第33行写几十里，how 照条目。
赫班挡的那一尊条目写只给模型，文字一律写最强的那一尊，beast 挂了安托士显像，挂不挂请主会话定。
赫班、达尔凯两幅里卡尔泽因、维斯洛照新添说明不写 who，只在 text 里写背影，要不要把他们的立绘挂进来请主会话定。
who 里名字留在哪那一句只给戈德伦带上了，另外六位凝名的事写完已近一百二十字，没有放进去。
七位都是成年人，都写 raw，没有 young。
